## Description

The Relay terminal path intermittently stops delivering output in the middle of a numbered burst. The canonical `terminal-consistency-faults` witnesses detect it with their stall bound and then pass on retry, so the E2E gate step is green while the full-gate per-ID attestation rejects the run (`full Playwright report is not an all-Pass run`). While it lasts, it blocks every merge-SHA E2E criterion for unrelated issues, and a user sees a terminal stop mid-stream with nothing surfaced.

Measured on 2026-10-21 (each of these passed on a retry of the same test at the same SHA):

- `RC-1000 stream stalled at RC-215 for 45000ms` — PR #2175 selected lane attempt 1, run 39606851829.
- `RC-1000 stream stalled at RC-73 for 45000ms` — same run attempt 2.
- `HV-5000 stream stalled at HV-4732 for 60000ms` — same run attempt 3.
- `RC-1000 stream stalled at RC-980` and `MC-600 stream stalled at MC-550` — PR #2172 attempt 2, run 39600945930.
- `HV-5000 stream stalled at HV-597 for 60000ms` — main push `d8b1e77`, run 39558971645 attempt 2.
- `MC-600 stream stalled at MC-93 for 45000ms` — main push `d8b1e77`, run 39558971645 attempt 1.

The stall happens with a single Relay client (RC, HV) as well as with two (MC), so it is not specific to the multi-client fixture; #2144's observer-isolation proof is not the reproduction.

## Reproduction

Run the Issue-selected `terminal-consistency-faults` lane (`workers: 1`, four browser tests) or the full E2E gate on main/PR. The first attempt of one of the Relay-heavy tests stalls; a retry of the same test passes on the same provisioned stack.

## Investigation Status

Root cause not verified. The provisioned stack's server/agent output goes to the E2E job's temporary provision log, which is not uploaded as an artifact, so the layer that parks the stream cannot yet be correlated with the stall point. Candidates, in the order the missing evidence would settle them:

1. the Server terminal stall grace closing the Relay connection (`OutboundError::Stalled` in `crates/nession-server/src/server/outbound.rs`), after which the client receives nothing further;
2. the Agent's per-subscriber queue evicting a subscriber (`detached_for_not_draining` in `crates/nession-agent/src/server/websocket.rs`), which ends that subscription silently;
3. tmux control-client back-pressure stalling the shared tmux server while one client's output pipe is full.

The stall point varies from line 73 to line 4732 and retries pass, which reads as a transient back-pressure/timing condition rather than a deterministic routing defect.

## Impact

- Merge-SHA E2E attestation is intermittently red, blocking evidence for issues that are otherwise complete.
- Relay users can lose the remainder of a stream with no error or recovery signal.

## Fix Direction

1. Capture the provision log (server/agent stderr) as a failure artifact in the E2E workflow.
2. Reproduce with one Relay client and correlate the stall point with the stall-grace and subscriber-detach logs.
3. Fix at the owning layer named by that correlation; do not weaken the fixture's stall detector or the all-Pass receipt.

## Location

- `crates/nession-server/src/server/outbound.rs` — terminal lane stall grace
- `crates/nession-server/src/server/websocket.rs` — relay forwarding loop
- `crates/nession-agent/src/server/websocket.rs` — per-subscriber queue, `detached_for_not_draining`, fan-out
- `.github/workflows/e2e-tests.yml` — provision log capture on failure
- `e2e/tests/browser/terminal-consistency-faults.spec.ts` — RC/HV/MC witnesses

### Success Criteria

- [ ] SC-01 A single-client Relay numbered burst (RC and HV) delivers every tail line exactly once on the first attempt of the selected lane, with the stack's provision log captured as an artifact when a run fails.
- [ ] SC-02 The layer that stalls the stream is identified from the captured logs and repaired at that owner (Server stall grace, Agent subscriber detach, or tmux back-pressure), not by weakening the fixture's stall bound or the full-gate all-Pass receipt.

## Acceptance Plan

```yaml
acceptance:
  SC-01:
    when: pr
    method: agent
  SC-02:
    when: merged
    branch: main
    method: agent
```

| SC-02 | Pending | awaiting merged main SHA Agent proof |
